walkthrough: Goal: practise several times in a day and see the day's work follow down one sheet, as on a paper pad, instead of a new sheet for every drill and session. D marks what differs from before.

A drill on a day with no sheet: gallery, Practice options, the Line tile. A sheet opens on the first pair at the usual opening zoom, its How first; Got it. D: the paper goes on below the row, laid ahead for the day. I copy the line with Draw and Compare. I spread two fingers to look closer, then pinch quickly inwards: D: the row in hand fits the screen, not the whole sheet (the zoom's range is a row's, as on a one-row drill before). Next through the six lines, Finish. D: the view settles on the rows used so far, not on the empty paper below; the card says Line drill done.

One more. D: the sheet stays; the next drill is laid from a new row under the first and the view glides down to its first pair at the zoom I had before Finish, the first drill's rows still visible above. Its How first; Got it. I copy its first line. Undo takes that line back; a second Undo changes nothing: the first drill's line stays (Next and One more cut the history to the exercise shown). Redo brings the line back. Next through the six, Finish: the rows used are now four.
The practice book, today tapped. D: the day's card shows one picture, the sheet cropped to the rows used, named by its lessons joined: Line drill 1 · Line drill 2; the time as before.

A session later the same day: Gallery, Start practice. D: today's sheet opens on the session's first pair, from the fifth row, the morning's drills above it (its last lesson was finished and the session fits the rows left; else a new sheet as before). Its warm-up's line needs no How (lines were compared in the drills). I copy the warm-up's first line and leave for the gallery: Continue practice. The app is closed and started again (a library of practice sheets alone opens on a blank canvas): Gallery, Continue practice reopens the sheet at the pair in hand.

The day changes (the app left overnight). Practice options, the Line tile: D: the drill gets a sheet of its own, for the sheet with the session is yesterday's and its session unfinished; a sheet is today's when it was started on today's local day. Gallery: the Today card still offers Continue practice for the unfinished session, which stays on its own sheet.

Failure: a lesson that does not fit the rows left (a stage-1 session is six or seven rows) or a sheet from before the day's sheet (its canvas holds only the rows it used) gives a new sheet as before; One more's lesson not stored rolls back, the summary and the view as they were, with the words a failed save shows (the app's tests). A long colour copy keeps a sheet of its own. Nothing else changes: Compare, the summary, the road and the seals count lessons as before.
Not here: a test drill's One more (a test lesson in place, the app's tests); the tablet's memory and time for the taller sheet (the device run).
